name_note: GTDB splits the classical species into parts; s__Lachnospira eligens_A holds genomes that carry the NCBI name Lachnospira eligens.

sentences.text: Lachnospira eligens is a member of the family Lachnospiraceae detected in shotgun metagenomic data from Chinese adults.
In 684 Chinese adults, abundance of Lachnospira eligens was positively associated with lumbar bone mass density, independent of age, diet habits and lifestyles.
Regular runners were reported to have increased relative abundance of carbohydrate-fermenting, short-chain fatty acid-producing species including Lachnospira eligens.
In a cobalt wire-induced rat epilepsy model, daily oral gavage of Lachnospira eligens reduced grade 4-5 seizure frequency, prolonged seizure latency and increased serum butyrate.
In one cohort analysis, Lachnospira eligens was among species replicated as associated with dyslipidemia in an external validation cohort.
